info.title: Azure Migrate Platform Landing Zones Service
info.description: Azure Migrate Platform Landing Zones management API. Captures the architectural intent for an Azure Landing Zone deployment associated with a migrate project.

MigrateProject.description: A Migrate project Resource. Defined locally as the parent for PlatformLandingZone; the canonical resource is owned by the sibling Microsoft.Migrate TypeSpec projects.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

MigrateProjectProperties.description: Properties of a migrate project. Minimal stub used solely to anchor PlatformLandingZone as a child resource; the full property set is defined by the sibling Microsoft.Migrate TypeSpec projects.

NoExpressRouteConfig.description: Configuration indicating that no ExpressRoute gateway is deployed.

NoFirewallConfig.description: Configuration indicating that no firewall is deployed.

NoVpnGatewayConfig.description: Configuration indicating that no virtual private network gateway is deployed.

values.name: Other
values.description: The network virtual appliance vendor is not specified.

PlatformLandingZone.description: Platform Landing Zone resource. Captures the architectural intent for an Azure Landing Zone deployment associated with a migrate project.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

PlatformLandingZoneListResult.description: The response of a PlatformLandingZone list operation.

value.description: The PlatformLandingZone items on this page

nextLink.description: The link to the next page of items

PlatformLandingZoneProperties.description: Properties of a Platform Landing Zone. This envelope is grown incrementally as sub-blocks are introduced.

scaleTier.description: Deployment scale for the platform landing zone. ManagementOnly omits connectivity.

parentManagementGroupId.description: Azure resource identifier of the parent management group under which the Azure Landing Zones management-group hierarchy will be created. Create-only; cannot be changed after the landing zone is created.

regions.description: Azure regions included in the landing zone design.

versionControlSystem.description: Version control system the generator will use when materializing the landing-zone infrastructure-as-code output and continuous integration pipelines. When omitted, the generator service applies its default (currently GitHub).

organizationName.description: Name of the organization or environment that owns this landing zone. Surfaced to the generator (maps to ENVIRONMENT_NAME). Optional.

serviceName.description: Name of the service associated with this landing zone. Surfaced to the generator (maps to SERVICE_NAME). Optional.

provisioningState.description: Provisioning state of the Platform Landing Zone resource.

status.description: Status of the asynchronous landing-zone generation run.

artifactId.description: Azure resource identifier of the artifact ({migrateProjectId}/artifacts/plz-{name}) under which the generated design document and infrastructure-as-code output are committed. Read-only and deterministic (derived from the resource identity), so it is available immediately, even while provisioning.

PlatformRegion.description: An Azure region included in the landing zone design.

role.description: Role of this region within the landing zone.

addressSpace.description: Address space allocated to platform services in this region.

availabilityZones.description: Availability zones in this region that the landing zone targets, for example ["1","2","3"]. Empty when the region does not support availability zones or zonal deployment is not desired.

connectivityDeploymentMode.description: Connectivity resources deployed in this region.

PlatformSubscriptionModel.description: Subscription model recorded for platform-tier workloads.

values.name: Dedicated
values.description: Each platform function uses a dedicated subscription.

PlatformSubscriptions.description: Platform subscription topology. The concrete shape is selected by the discriminator "subscriptionModel".

PolicyAssignmentMode.description: Policy assignment baseline for the platform landing zone.

values.name: AlzDefaults
values.description: Apply the canonical Azure Landing Zone policy baseline.

PolicyAssignmentOverride.description: Override applied to an Azure Landing Zones policy assignment.

scope.description: Azure Landing Zones management-group scope at which the override applies.

assignmentName.description: Name of the Azure Landing Zones policy assignment.

enabled.description: Whether the policy assignment is deployed.

enforcementMode.description: Enforcement mode applied to the policy assignment.

effect.description: Effect applied to all definitions in the policy assignment.

parameters.description: Parameter overrides applied to the policy assignment.

PolicyEffect.description: Effect applied by an Azure Policy assignment override.

values.name: DeployIfNotExists
values.description: Deploy a resource when it does not exist.

values.name: AuditIfNotExists
values.description: Audit when a related resource does not exist.

PolicyEnforcementMode.description: Enforcement mode applied to an Azure Policy assignment.

values.name: DoNotEnforce
values.description: Evaluate compliance without enforcing the policy assignment.

PolicyParameterOverride.description: Azure Policy parameter override applied to an assignment.

name.description: Parameter name defined by the policy assignment.

zoneMode.description: Private domain name system zone deployment mode.

centralizedResolutionEnabled.description: Whether centralized domain name system resolution is enabled.

autoRegistrationZoneName.description: Name of the auto-registration private domain name system zone.

resolverSubnetAddressPrefix.description: Domain name system resolver subnet address prefix.

PrivateDnsZoneMode.description: Private domain name system zone deployment mode.

values.name: None
values.description: Do not deploy private domain name system zones or centralized resolution resources.

values.name: PrivateLinkAndAutoRegistration
values.description: Deploy Azure Private Link private DNS zones and an auto-registration private DNS zone.

RegionAddressSpace.description: Address space allocated to platform services in a given region.

hub.description: Address space allocated for hub virtual networks in this region, in Classless Inter-Domain Routing notation.

RegionRole.description: Role of an Azure region within the landing zone.

RegionalConnectivityDeploymentMode.description: Connectivity resources deployed in an Azure region.

values.name: None
values.description: Do not deploy regional connectivity resources.

values.name: Sidecar
values.description: Deploy only the sidecar virtual network.

values.name: HubAndSidecar
values.description: Deploy both the connectivity hub and the sidecar virtual network.

defenderForCloudEnabled.description: Whether Microsoft Defender for Cloud configuration is enabled.
